summary: Join our comprehensive Oil and Gas Data Analytics and Big Data Training Course. Gain essential skills to analyze data and drive efficiency in energy operations.
lede: Drilling performance analytics uses structured data workflows to validate well and drilling records and connect operational data with decisions. For petroleum engineers, drilling data specialists, production analysts, and reliability professionals, the course covers data profiling, SQL and Python preparation, production trend and downtime analysis, anomaly detection, and KPI dashboards, with practice validating WITSML feeds and reporting findings.
audienceIntro: Oil and Gas Data Analytics and Big Data Training is designed for professionals who work with technical, operational, and commercial data across upstream, midstream, and downstream activities. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who can interpret domain information and want stronger analytical workflows.
modules: SQL and Python for Petroleum Data
prerequisites: Working knowledge of oil and gas operations, engineering data, or asset management is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets, basic SQL, or data visualisation is useful. No advanced programming background is required, and completion does not require production software deployment. Python and Apache Spark activities focus on guided operational application. Bring a laptop if available.
